# Vendored artifacts (out-of-the-box build, no Sail toolchain needed)

- `sail_riscv_model.cpp.gz` + `sail_riscv_model.h` — C++ generated by
  **Sail 0.20.3's `--cpp` backend** from
  [riscv/sail-riscv](https://github.com/riscv/sail-riscv) at the commit in
  `SAIL_RISCV_COMMIT`, plus this crate's `sail/harness.sail`, by
  `scripts/gen_model.sh` (which ends with `scripts/fix_cpp_model.py`: the
  backend's file-scope GMP scratch is created/killed by every instance's
  `model_init`/`model_fini`, so it is refcounted to the first/last
  instance). The model is a C++ class (`hart::Model`): all architectural
  state is per instance. License: BSD-2-Clause (`riscv/LICENCE`).
- `riscv/riscv_platform_if.{h,cpp}`, `riscv/riscv_softfloat.{h,cpp}` —
  copied unchanged from sail-riscv's `c_emulator/` (the platform-callback base
  class the model derives from, and the SoftFloat glue the model calls).
  License: BSD-2-Clause (`riscv/LICENCE`).
- `config/rv64.json`, `config/rv32.json` — sail-riscv's
  `build/config/rv64d_v256_e64.json` / `rv32d_v256_e64.json` (generated from
  `config/config.json.in` by its CMake build), unchanged; the oracle's own
  defaults (WFI/WRS as nops, VLEN set explicitly) are applied as overrides in
  `src/lib.rs`.
- `softfloat/` — Berkeley SoftFloat Release 3 as bundled in sail-riscv's
  `dependencies/softfloat/berkeley-softfloat-3`: `source/*.c`,
  `source/include/*.h`, `source/RISCV/*` (the RISC-V NaN specialization),
  minus the multi-word (`*M`) sources sail-riscv's CMake also leaves out
  under `SOFTFLOAT_FAST_INT64`. `platform.h` is this crate's (GCC/Clang get
  the builtin-clz and `__int128` paths like upstream's `Linux-x86_64-GCC`,
  kept as `platform.upstream.h`; MSVC uses the portable C code).
  License: BSD-3-Clause (`softfloat/COPYING.txt`).
- `sail-runtime/` — the Sail C runtime from the `sail` 0.20.3 opam package
  (`$(opam var share)/sail/lib`), identical to the 0.20.1 copy patched for
  sail-aarch64-oracle, with the same patches (marked `PORTABILITY PATCH` /
  `REENTRANCY PATCH` / `CPP-BACKEND PATCH`: bundled mini-gmp, no `gmp_*printf`/
  `gmp_sscanf`, MSVC getopt/getline/`ssize_t`, `elf.c` dropped, refcounted
  `setup_rts`, `sint`/`sub_vec_int` aliases, the LLP64 64-bit fix in `sail.h`,
  `sail_addr_mapped`) plus one for this crate:
  - `sail_config_swap()` (`sail_config.{c,h}`): sail-riscv reads its JSON
    configuration during execution, so each instance keeps its own parsed
    tree and the shim swaps it in around every call.
  License: BSD-2-Clause (Sail authors); cJSON is MIT.
- `sail-runtime/mini-gmp.{c,h}`, `mini-mpq.{c,h}` — from **GMP 6.3.0**.
  ⚠️ License: **dual LGPLv3+ / GPLv2+** — unlike the rest of the crate.

`build.rs` uses all of this automatically when `RISCV_ORACLE_SAIL_MODEL_C` is
not set; `sail_riscv_model.cpp.gz` (19 MB → 2.2 MB) is decompressed into
`OUT_DIR` at build time.

To refresh after a sail-riscv update (in WSL2/Linux, see the README):

```sh
sh scripts/gen_model.sh ~/sail-riscv                       # model + header + commit
cp ~/sail-riscv/build/config/rv64d_v256_e64.json vendor/config/rv64.json   # needs a
cp ~/sail-riscv/build/config/rv32d_v256_e64.json vendor/config/rv32.json   # CMake build
cp ~/sail-riscv/c_emulator/riscv_platform_if.{h,cpp} \
   ~/sail-riscv/c_emulator/riscv_softfloat.{h,cpp} vendor/riscv/
```

Re-copy `sail-runtime/` only when Sail itself is upgraded, and then re-apply
the patch hunks.
